verdict.rationale: Fireflies ships AskFred, an in-product AI assistant that answers natural-language questions about single or multiple meetings and keeps context across follow-ups. It also auto-generates notes, action items, customized summaries and conversation-intelligence analytics from the user's meeting data. Missing for 10: explicit evidence of proactive AI suggestions or recommendations beyond Q&A, summaries and action items, and no independent or hands-on corroboration of insight quality.
